judgment_text:
Prayer : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for issuance of writ of certiorarified Mandamus call for the records pertaining to the impugned order passed by the 3rd respondent office vide proceedings in T.R. 2025/N103-34-026501TR dated 29-9-2025 and quash the same as illegal and consequently direct Respondents 1 to 4 to restore the Patta bearing No. 440 given in favour of the petitioners father

ORDER

When the matter was taken up for hearing, the learned counsel for the petitioner confined his prayer to seeking liberty to prefer an appeal against the impugned order dated 29-9-2025.

2. Granting such libety, this writ petition stands disposed of. No costs. Consequently, the connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
